from datetime import datetime
import re
pw_list=apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords(); file_pw=[x['password'] for x in pw_list if x['account_name']=='file_system'][0]
access_token=apis.file_system.login(username='chrharrison@gmail.com', password=file_pw)['access_token']
year=datetime.now().year
cable_files=apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=access_token, directory_path='~/bills/cable/', recursive=True, entry_type='all')
files=[p for p in cable_files if f'/{year}-' in p and p.endswith('.txt')]
files=sorted(files)
print('files', files)
totals=[]
for fp in files:
    content=apis.file_system.show_file(access_token=access_token, file_path=fp)['content']
    m=re.search(r'Total Amount\s*=>\s*\$?\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]{1,2})?)', content)
    print('file', fp, 'match', m.group(1) if m else None)
    if m:
        totals.append(float(m.group(1)))
print('totals', totals)
print('sum', sum(totals))
